summary: Induction on j, enlarging L by max(L, |p_j|⁻¹, |q_j|⁻¹).

steps.lean:
have n {L B R} {x : ℂˣ} (c : L ^ K ≤ B) (h : ‖x.1‖ ≤ R) (_ : 1 ≤ L) (_ : 1 ≤ R) :
      max L ‖x.1‖⁻¹ ^ K ≤ B * (R ^ (K + 6) * dampedPower K ‖x.1‖⁻¹) := by
    grw [dampedPower, ← c, max_def, min_def]
    split_ifs <;> simp [field, pow_add] <;> (try grw [h]) <;> bound
steps.claim: n: if L^K ≤ B, |x| ≤ R, L ≥ 1, R ≥ 1, then max(L, |x|⁻¹)^K ≤ B·R^{K+6}·dampedPower(K, |x|⁻¹).
steps.typed_fact: max L ‖x.1‖⁻¹ ^ K ≤ B * (R ^ (K + 6) * dampedPower K ‖x.1‖⁻¹)

steps.claim: Unfold IsHead for the gauge (sizes |·| ≤ L^j) and headWeight.

steps.lean:
refine' j.rec ⟨ρ, by simp; grw [← le_self_add]; bound [hF.ten_le]⟩
    fun j ⟨L, a, b, h, c⟩ ↦ ⟨_, _, _, _, fun R r z ↦ (n (n (c R r _) (z _ .refl).1 ..) (z _
    .refl).2 ..).trans_eq (by simp [prod_range_succ]; ring)⟩ <;> clear n <;> grind [hF.ten_le]
steps.claim: Induction on j: L = ρ for j = 0; at j + 1 take L' = max(max(L, |p_j-product|⁻¹), |q_j-product|⁻¹) and apply n twice (with the partial products bounded by R).
